drives.summary: Decided to water **orchid-bed** today. Its moisture is 12%, well below its 25% threshold, and its bed note warns it is slow to recover once it dries out (a past loss started at 14%). The other two beds — fern-bed at 42% (threshold 30%) and moss-bench at 61% (threshold 55%) — are both above their thresholds and do not need watering. Decision written to scratch as watering-decision-2026-08-03.md.
